messages:
erin: Flagging invoice CR-4027 from CloudRack. Vendor applied a retroactive usage credit after we pulled the close extract. It zeroed the customer balance but changed deferred revenue allocation.

billing-bot: System note: Credit CR-4027 applied to INV-1204 at 2024-08-19T18:04:12Z

diego: Can you share the adjusted lines? we need to know which product codes lost deferred revenue.

erin: Paste from refund file: 
```
INV-1204 original: 
- Hosted-API usage  12,300 tokens -> $7.38  (deferred hosted-api GL 2201)
- Experimental pilot credit -$7.38  (should have matched hosted-api but vendor hit EXP-PRICING code)
credit CR-4027: refund applied to line EXP-PRICING (product code EXP-1)
```
So vendor's refund targeted EXP-1; our extract already moved $7.38 into the EXP deferral bucket for August.

katie: That will understate hosted-api deferred revenue and overstate experimental. We can't change the vendor invoice. Options: 1) manual reclass JE before close, 2) leave as-is and document as variance, or 3) adjust next month's deferrals. I vote for 1) to keep product-level metrics clean.

trevor: Agree. Small amount but prefer reclass. Draft JE proposal: 
```
DR Deferred Revenue - Experimental (GL 2206) 7.38
CR Deferred Revenue - Hosted API (GL 2201)   7.38
Memo: Reclass due to vendor credit misapplied to experimental product code on CR-4027; customer still hosted usage.
```

diego: Confirming GL 2206 is experimental deferrals? we use 2205 in some docs. which is current?

erin: Revops: please confirm the experimental GL code.

revops: Confirmed - for current chart 2206 = Deferred - Experimental Trials. 2201 = Deferred - Hosted API. JE above good. Also flagging: we need to update the reconciliation macro so the close workbook doesn't pick vendor product code as the source of truth when a credit line is present. We'll add a rule to preference original usage mapping if a credit nets to zero.

katie: Can someone attach the vendor credit PDF and the Chargebee change log to the close folder? Also add a short audit note so external auditors understand this reclass.

trevor: I'll post JE after review: JE #2024-08-CL-6021, posted 2024-08-19 20:12Z. Tagged as month-end adjustment and linked to CR-4027.

billing-bot: Automated entry: JE #2024-08-CL-6021 posted by trevor at 2024-08-19T20:12:55Z

erin: Reconciliation macro change: diego, can you add a conditional: if invoice contains both usage and credit lines and net = 0, map credit to the usage product before aggregation. This avoids artificial product leakage.

diego: Will implement. Also adding a unit test to the mapping rules and will run the close extract again to ensure totals match GL. ETA: 2 hours.

katie: Thanks. Once diego confirms the extract, I'll sign off on the close tracker. Note: no P&L impact per revops, balance sheet reclassification only.

erin: Closing loop: files uploaded to /close/2024-08 with PDF and vendor communication. JE number in tracker. Closing thread.
